text:
Priya - People Ops: Heads-up: were updating the Bereavement Leave policy today. Key changes: up to 5 paid days for immediate family bereavement (previously 3), optional one-time travel stipend up to $1,500 for in-country travel to attend services or manage affairs, and an expedited short-claim process if someone is in transit. Policy & claim form: https://redwoodintra.company/policies/bereavement-update

Aaron: Thank you 44dTwo quick questions: 1) who qualifies as immediate family? 2) does the stipend require receipts?

Priya - People Ops: Great Qs 4dd1) Immediate family = spouse/partner, children, parents, siblings, grandparents, and any person youve legally recognized as next of kin (we included examples in the doc). 2) Stipend: we allow provisional payout up to $500 without receipts to cover urgent travel; full reimbursement (up to $1,500) needs receipts submitted within 60 days.

Nia: Manager workflow? If someone needs the days now, how do I approve fast?

Priya - People Ops: Approve in Workday under "Bereavement" and flag as "expedited". If immediate, do the quick-approve and notify People Ops within 5 business days for case review. We will not delay emergency approvals.

Payroll-Bot: Official doc uploaded: https://redwoodintra.company/policies/bereavement-update.pdf. Note: stipend payments are taxable and will be processed on the next payroll cycle.

Priya - People Ops: Were hosting a short manager-only walkthrough tomorrow 8:30am PT in #people-ops-office-hours to cover examples and the admin flow. RSVP link in the policy doc. Thanks everyone.
